alt: Time bar from 0 to 150 seconds per input showing the enforced 60 s limit, the promised 150 s, and the zone between marked as promised but scored 0; a test submission taking 13 s per test case (65 s per input) times out on all 50 inputs under the original grader and is fully scored by the fixed version with its 150 s limit.
caption: The prompt promises 30 s per test case, 150 s per input, but the original grader enforces 60 s, so a solver that takes more than 60 s on any input, though within the promise, loses its whole score.
